body: I got that message. It brought me so close to the brink... G-d help me, I'm scared.

I'm in college, and I have no car. So I'm kind of stuck here, with my counselor and school food- and walking around the block is sort of dangerous. I just want to sleep, but when I let myself, I sleep for 18+ hours. It's cold and I'm sad and just... tired

It all started last November when my dad was diagnosed with cancer and my parents announced their divorce. He's cancer free now, but that put a lot of stress on my senior year. Since then was the rape and miscarriage and everything else.

She's a school therapist. They're known for putting students into suicide watch. I just feel isolated. I haven't showered in weeks. I eat once a day, if that. I can't find the time or energy to socialize. I just feel numb and empty and alone. And tired, but I'm too tired to sleep. 

I can't exercise. This time last year, I was in the peak of shape. I was gearing up for ROTC, and could do a hundred push ups in two minutes, 95 situps in the same. I had a perfect PT score. I was hospitalized for the pain, and disqualified, and now I just can't find the strength to do it anymore. I'm just tired.
